pythonFunction.name: fetch_account_by_ani
pythonFunction.description:
Silently looks up the customer account linked to the caller's phone number (caller id) and, on a
single match, marks the caller Identified. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    ani: Caller phone number in any common format (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, found, auth_status, account_id, customer_name, customer_type, jurisdiction,
    balance and due_date; found=false when the number is not linked to exactly one account.
